title: QRÖMELIFE
excerpt: Quavo has released *QRÖMELIFE*, a 14-track solo album executive produced by Pharrell Williams and the follow-up to 2023's *Rocket Power*.
body:
Quavo has released *QRÖMELIFE*, a 14-track solo album executive produced by Pharrell Williams and the follow-up to 2023's *Rocket Power*. The new record still carries the loss of Takeoff, but it is built around a different question than its predecessor. Instead of making grief the subject of nearly every turn, Quavo is writing about what daily life looks like once grief has become part of it.

That idea is inside the title. Quavo uses "qrome" for the state of carrying on after something difficult has happened, borrowing the sound of the word from "chromosome." His explanation is deliberately ordinary. People lose someone, get hurt or go through a bad stretch, then still have to wake up and go to work. The experience stays with them without stopping the rest of life.

Pharrell worked closely on the album for more than a year and a half, with sessions taking place at Louis Vuitton's headquarters in Paris and on a yacht in Miami. Quavo has said the collaboration pushed him back toward the versatility that once let him move easily between Migos records, solo hits and features. That matters on *QRÖMELIFE* because the album rarely settles into the mournful tone that dominated *Rocket Power*.

[apple:album:6817200688]

"Away" brings Offset onto the album after the two repaired a relationship that had fractured publicly before Takeoff's death. Their reunion is not presented as a Migos replacement. Quavo and Offset have separately begun working through material for another Migos project, and Quavo has said any release would have to respect Takeoff's role in the group rather than simply use the name without him.

Fatherhood is another new fact around the record. Quavo recently revealed that he has become a father to a daughter. His own father died when he was four, and he has spoken about wanting to give his child the presence he did not have growing up. The short film used to introduce *QRÖMELIFE* ends with him holding his daughter, placing that change in his private life inside the album's story without turning it into a separate promotional subplot.

The album also arrived during an unexpected second life for "HOTEL LOBBY (Unc & Phew)," Quavo and Takeoff's 2022 single. Clips of the pair performing it have been pulled into a wave of AI-generated videos, something Quavo has admitted can be difficult to watch. He also said the resurgence feels bigger to him than an internet trend because it keeps Takeoff present for people who still care about the music. For all his discomfort with the technology around those videos, he said he is grateful that people are still saying his nephew's name.
